title: WorkFeedback - Data API
description: Represents the answer to a question that a person was asked via a feedback request. Also used to store offered feedback without linking it to a particular question.

Feedback.description: Contains either the free-form text of the answer, or the choice selected by the user. Max length is 65536.

Name.properties: Autonumber, Defaulted on create, Filter, idLookup, Sort
Name.description: The name of the WorkFeedback record.

OwnerId.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
OwnerId.description: ID of the owner of the WorkFeedback record.

QuestionId.description: The question this answer applies to. When this feedback is linked to a request of an unsolicited type, the question ID is null.

RequestId.description: The ID of the request this response belongs to, in case of offered feedback.

associated_objects:
This object has the following associated objects. Unless noted, they are available in the same API version as this object.

- **WorkFeedbackOwnerSharingRule**: Sharing rules are available for the object.
- **WorkFeedbackShare**: Sharing is available for the object.
